verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code-first open-source Python framework, so bot building, pipelines, recording, transcripts and metrics are all configured programmatically. Its official CLI also covers Pipecat Cloud deployment, giving a programmatic path for that cloud action. However, nothing documents parity between the Pipecat Cloud UI and an API, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: a documented Pipecat Cloud management API, an explicit UI/API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration that dashboard actions can be done programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
`pipecat --help` lists init (project scaffolding), cloud (deploy to Pipecat Cloud), eval (behavioral evals), and context-hub
Coordinate voice, video, text, and images in one pipeline, with frame-level control over every step of the conversation.
